---
title: "embedpdf names for screen readers"
resources:
  - "files/sample copy.pdf"
---

Both embeds show `files/sample copy.pdf`, a copy of `sample.pdf` in a
subfolder. The first gives the path with a space, and the second gives it with
`%20`. A screen reader names each one "PDF: sample copy.pdf". The checks in
`tests/` read that name.

## Path with a space

{{< pdf "files/sample copy.pdf" renderer=pdfjs >}}

## Path with %20

{{< pdf files/sample%20copy.pdf renderer=pdfjs >}}
